sources.title: CladeTeam/CENO-600M-1m · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: CENO-600M-1m is the long-context (1M) checkpoint of the 600M CENO DNA foundation model — a causal language model over genomic sequence built on a Nemotron-H Mamba / Attention / Mixture-of-Experts hybrid backbone (no MSA inputs).

sources.title: GitHub - CladeTeam/CENO
sources.snippet: Model weights are published on the HuggingFace Hub under the CladeTeam organization — see the CENO collection. There are 15 checkpoints in two families: CENO — base DNA foundation model (bfloat16), for generation / single-sequence scoring. Four sizes (80M / 300M / 600M / 1B) × three training-context stages (base / 131k / 1m) = 12 checkpoints, e.g. CladeTeam/CENO-1B-base. CENO-P — MSA ...
